headline: Uzbekistan and Oman Double Joint Investment Capital to $500 Million
summary: Uzbekistan and Oman elevated bilateral ties to a strategic partnership, agreeing to double their joint investment fund to $500 million and establish a working group for mining and copper exploration.
why: Central Asian nations are actively courting Gulf capital to modernise mineral processing, transport links, and industrial infrastructure.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Doubling joint investment capital to $500 million channels fresh funding into Uzbek copper and mining projects.
